summary: Elemental Royalty Corp filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release announcing record quarterly revenue and adjusted EBITDA for Q1 2026. The filing reports financial results and an inaugural dividend, with no event triggering a special situation classification. As a routine earnings release, it does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return program, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change. The filing is a standard periodic report by a foreign private issuer.
